title: Lathe a profile into a solid or a hollow shell
purpose: Revolve a list of radius and height points around Z into a solid of revolution, with poles on the axis, Chaikin rounding, partial sweeps and an optional wall thickness that turns an outline into a closed hollow vessel. Use it for vases, bottles, cups, lamps and turned parts.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Profile points as radius,height pairs from bottom to top, separated by semicolons.

parameters.name: thickness
parameters.description: Wall thickness of a hollow shell; 0 revolves the profile as given.

parameters.name: rounding
parameters.description: Chaikin corner-cutting passes applied to the profile first.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: Sweep angle; below 360 the cut faces are left open.

outputs.description: One closed mesh object named Lathe with a UVMap, axis along Z.

limits: The shell offset moves each profile point along its averaged normal, so very sharp inner corners or walls thicker than the local curvature allows can fold; such outlines are refused only when the offset crosses the axis. A shell needs a full sweep and an open top. UVs are cylindrical and stretch near the poles. Verified in Blender 5.2.1; written for the 4.2 API.
technique_references: Surface of revolution with single pole vertices on the axis
